# Security policy

Lineater's threat model, OAuth boundaries, and release checklist live in [`docs/SECURITY.md`](../docs/SECURITY.md).

## Reporting

Use [GitHub security advisories](https://github.com/benbugraer/lineater/security/advisories/new) for vulnerabilities.

Do not include access tokens, refresh tokens, OAuth codes, `config.json`, SQLite databases, or private Linear issue content. Include only sanitized reproduction steps.
